svg.title: Changing the direction of an ESPARGOS transmit beam

cc:Work.dc:title: Changing the direction of an ESPARGOS transmit beam
cc:Work.dc:description: Ideal horizontal power cuts for the ESPARGOS One geometry at 2.44 GHz. The peaks move from 0 to 25 degrees with the commanded steering.
